newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech shares mixed at PSE daily price fixing.
newsitem.headline: Czech shares mixed at PSE daily price fixing.

text.p: Czech major shares were mixed at the daily price fixing on the Prague Stock Exchange on Thursdday, with gains to Komercni Banka and Chemopetrol offsetting losses by SPT Telecom and Skoda.
The Reuters RPIX index dropped 4.0 points to 1,034.6 while the PX50 index, helped by broader market gains, edged up 0.5 points to 500.3.
Komercni and Chemopetrol rose 16 crowns and 15 crowns respectively. SPT lost five crowns while Skoda was down 29 crowns.
